title: Warm Crispy Vietnamese Chicken Banh Mi
description: A crispy and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring chicken, cranberry, and dairy-free friendly ingredients, served in a claypot.
instructions: Heat the claypot over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil.
Add the chicken to the claypot and cook until browned and crispy.
Remove the chicken from the claypot and set aside.
Add the pickled carrots and daikon to the claypot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cranberry sauce and rice vinegar to the claypot and stir to combine.
Add the cooked chicken back to the claypot and stir to combine with the sauce.
Slice the banh mi bread in half and toast until crispy.
Assemble the banh mi by spreading the chicken and sauce mixture onto the bread and topping with cilantro.
Serve the banh mi hot and enjoy.
